parsed.rationale: After upgrading to v2.8, Salesforce production sync has been failing and is blocking reporting for ~40 enterprise customers; logs show repeated auth token refresh errors, indicating a post-upgrade integration/auth failure requiring urgent human/engineering investigation.

parsed.draft_response:
Hi there — thanks for reporting this. I’m sorry you’re seeing Salesforce production sync failures since the v2.8 upgrade, and that it’s blocking reporting for ~40 enterprise customers.

We’ve noted the auth token refresh errors in your logs and understand this is time-sensitive (especially with your renewal call tomorrow). We’ll escalate this for urgent engineering investigation.

To help us narrow it down quickly, could you please share the following (any partial info is fine):
1) The exact Salesforce sync component/feature name involved (module/setting name) and whether this impacts all Salesforce connections or only a subset of customers/accounts.
2) The exact error text(s) and/or error code(s) from the auth token refresh failures (a few consecutive log lines are ideal).
3) The start time of the failures relative to the v2.8 upgrade (timestamp + timezone).
4) Where in your system the logs are located and whether you can provide correlation IDs/request IDs for the failed refresh attempts.

In the meantime, if you have any mitigation attempts already tried (e.g., re-auth, token refresh retry, config changes) and whether the issue is currently continuously failing or intermittent, please include that as well.

Once we have the details above, we’ll continue the investigation with engineering and respond with the next steps. If there’s an urgent workaround you already have for reporting for the affected customers, tell us which orgs are impacted so we can advise on what to prioritize for your renewal call.
promised_actions: Escalate the issue to engineering for urgent investigation based on the post–v2.8 upgrade Salesforce sync failures and auth token refresh errors.
Request specific log excerpts, error codes/text, timestamps, scope (all vs subset), and correlation IDs to accelerate troubleshooting.
safety_notes: Avoid confirming root cause or providing timelines/SLA.
Acknowledge human review/escalation without claiming resolution.
Ask for minimal missing info (exact errors, timestamps, scope, correlation IDs).
Do not promise a refund or legal/compliance determinations.
